Polarized takes on institutional capture, regulatory overreach, and technological freedom resonate more than balanced perspectives. Nostalgic references to cypherpunk first principles mixed with forward-looking AI/inference talk. Self-directed learning (local models, running your own node) celebrated over guru-dependent consumption.
